description: Offline speech-to-text for Windows: 33 recognition languages, no cloud, no account, no telemetry
notes: The recognition model is not in the archive: on the first launch the program asks for a language and downloads one, about 50 MB for a small model and up to 1.8 GB for a large one. Per-language installers that already include a model are published at https://voxspica.4crytobot.xyz/ . The program is not code-signed, so Windows may warn about an unknown publisher.
